name: command-menu
title: Command Menu
purpose: Filter and invoke grouped commands through an inline query with an anchored dropdown or on-demand dialog.
accessibility: The inline query opens its anchored dropdown on focus, click, typing, or arrow navigation and closes on selection, Escape, Tab, or outside press.
The query uses combobox and active-descendant semantics against one listbox.
Dialog mode uses the established modal focus, scroll, and restoration contract.
commonMistakes: Hiding critical commands only behind a hotkey.
Changing the command model during internal filtering.

examples.title: Inline commands
examples.description: The editable query opens a filtered dropdown of grouped commands.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import CommandMenu from "@/components/ui/CommandMenu.vue";
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { CommandGroup } from "@/components/ui/command";

const open = ref(false);
const query = ref("");
const groups: readonly CommandGroup[] = [
  { id: "commands", label: "Commands placeholder", items: [
    { id: "home", label: "Home placeholder", keywords: ["start","navigation"], shortcut: "H" },
    { id: "docs", label: "Docs placeholder", keywords: ["guide","reference"], shortcut: "D" },
    { id: "create", label: "Create placeholder", keywords: ["new","action"], shortcut: "C" },
  ] },
];

function handleSelect(item: unknown): void {
  console.info("Selected", item);
}
</script>

<template>
  <CommandMenu id="command-palette" v-model="open" v-model:query="query" label="Commands placeholder" :groups="groups" size="sm" @select="handleSelect" />
</template>

examples.title: Dialog palette
examples.description: Modal mode opens on request and adds the platform command hotkey.

<script setup lang="ts">
import CommandMenu from "@/components/ui/CommandMenu.vue";
import Button from "@/components/ui/Button.vue";
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { CommandGroup } from "@/components/ui/command";

const open = ref(false);
const query = ref("");
const groups: readonly CommandGroup[] = [
  { id: "commands", label: "Commands placeholder", items: [
    { id: "home", label: "Home placeholder", keywords: ["start","navigation"], shortcut: "H" },
    { id: "docs", label: "Docs placeholder", keywords: ["guide","reference"], shortcut: "D" },
    { id: "create", label: "Create placeholder", keywords: ["new","action"], shortcut: "C" },
  ] },
];

function handleSelect(item: unknown): void {
  console.info("Selected", item);
}
</script>

<template>
  <Button @click="open = true">Open commands placeholder</Button>
  <CommandMenu id="command-palette" v-model="open" v-model:query="query" label="Commands placeholder" :groups="groups" mode="dialog" @select="handleSelect" />
</template>
